messages:
maya: :rotating_light: P99 spike on /v1/generate in us-west-2 since 09:02 UTC, ~4x. Traces point to kernel fallback on some shards + KV cache miss rate jumping. Also seeing streaming stalls. Anyone oncall?
ops-bot: Alert: grafana.redwood/prod-usw2/latency -> https://grafana.internal/g/dash?panel=generate_p99 (auto-attached).
serena: I'm on it. Looking at the trace dump now. Early observation: a group of requests have extremely long prompt lengths (30k-150k tokens-ish) and repeated tool annotations.
liam: curious — did we just roll the kernel selection tweak yesterday? there was a change that prefers fused-attn on A100 but falls back to reference on memory pressure.
jordan: FYI I saw a customer session that triggers repeated tool-calls in a loop (tool returns text that includes the trigger token). Could be self-amplifying request size. Example snippet from request body: `... invoke_tool("search") -> tool returns "invoke_tool(\"search\")" ...`
serena: that would explain prompt growth. Also the runtime logs show per-shard memory pressure leading to `kernel_choice: attention_ref` fallback for half the shard pool. log: ```[09:05:12] shard-12 kernel=attention_ref reason=kv_mem_pressure free_mem=1.2GB```
maya: nvidia-smi on gpu-7 shows high SM utilization plus host-side swapping spikes. Could be noisy neighbor (other tenant burst) -> eviction thrash in KV cache.
liam: stack of issues: tool loop -> enormous prompt -> KV cache churn -> memory pressure -> kernel fallback (slower) -> queues grow -> streaming backpressure -> timeouts.
serena: mitigation plan: 1) rate-limit/blacklist offending session (rollup rule) 2) temporarily increase kv_cache.max_entries on the shard group to reduce misses 3) pin critical routes to fused-attn kernel where possible (force-preferred) 4) throttle streaming chunk size for /v1/generate to avoid backpressure.
jordan: I'm taking the session and applying a short-lived block on the specific API key. Also will notify customer success.
infra-bot: Runbook actions started: throttle_rule_applied(session=ck_***, until=09:40), kv_cache_resize(requested=+25%), shard_pin(fused-attn) queued.
liam: small patch ready to disable the new kernel selection fallback heuristic while we investigate. Want to roll for 10m?
maya: please do. Rolling now to canary (3 nodes) -> monitoring.
ops-bot: grafana: p99 started dropping after 09:18 UTC. Link: https://grafana.internal/alert/12345
serena: re-checking traces: post-mitigation, KV miss rate down from 78% -> 18% on affected shards. Streaming stall logs reduced. Looks like the session block removed the amplification.
jordan: customer acknowledged they had an SDK bug that produced recursive tool output. CS is coordinating a patch.
maya: summary: root cause = recursive tool-calling loop from a customer session that inflated prompt length and caused KV cache thrash; noisy neighbor GPU exacerbated memory pressure causing kernel fallback to slower reference kernels; cascading effect caused p99 spike and streaming backpressure. Mitigations applied: session block, kv_cache resize, kernel selection rollback/pin, streaming throttle.
liam: follow-ups: (1) add detection for tool-call recursion patterns in request pipeline, (2) hard limits on prompt expansion in streaming, (3) improve kernel fallback telemetry to include reason tags and free_mem at decision time, (4) revisit eviction policy to prefer hot prefixes.
serena: I'll open the perf-investigation ticket with trace links + reproducer and assign follow-ups.
maya: :thumbsup: closing this thread once ticket is created. Thanks all.
